==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:assisten<ety:bor<fro:assister<ety:inh<la:assistō>>>>|tree=1}}
From {{inh|en|enm|assisten}}, from {{der|en|fro|assister|t=to assist, to attend}}, from {{der|en|la|assistō|t=stand at, bestand|pos=verb}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/əˈsɪst/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-assist.ogg|a=US}}
* {{hyphenation|en|as|sist}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɪst|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# To [[help]].
#: {{ux|en|This book will '''assist''' you in getting your life in order.}}
#: {{ux|en|Tutor feedback '''assists''' the learning process.}}
#* {{quote-journal
|en
|date=April 15, 2012
|author=Phil McNulty
|title=Tottenham 1-5 Chelsea
|work=BBC
|url=http://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/17649443
|page=
|passage=The referee seemed well placed to award the goal, but video evidence suggested the protests were well founded and the incident only strengthens the case of those lobbying for technology to '''assist''' officials.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140422130340/http://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/0/football/17649443|archivedate=22 April 2014}}
# {{lb|en|sports}} To make a pass that leads directly towards scoring.
# {{lb|en|medicine}} To help compensate for what is missing with the help of a medical technique or therapy.
# {{lb|en|archaic}} To [[stand]] (at a place) or to (an opinion).
#: {{ux|en|A great part of the nobility '''assisted''' to his opinion.}}
# {{lb|en|now|archaic}} To be [[present]] ({{m|en|at}} an event, occasion etc.).
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1789|author=w:Edward Gibbon|title=Memoirs of My Life|page=138|publisher=Penguin|year_published=1990
|passage=I '''assisted''' with pleasure at the representation of several tragedies and comedies.}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# A helpful action or an act of giving.
#: {{ux|en|The foundation gave a much needed '''assist''' to the shelter.}}
# {{lb|en|sports}} The act of helping another player score points or goals
## {{lb|en|soccer}} A decisive pass made to the goal [[scorer]]
##* {{RQ:Guardian|date=1 January 2016|author=David Hytner|title=Mesut Özil has Arsenal daring to dream of Premier League glory|url=http://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2016/jan/01/mesut-ozil-arsenal-premier-league-theo-walcott
|passage={{w|Mesut Özil|Özil}} has 16 assists in the Premier League and three goals; he has two more goals in the Champions League. On Monday, he took Bournemouth apart in the 2-0 win at the Emirates Stadium, setting up the first for Gabriel and scoring the second himself.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20261013140959/https://www.theguardian.com/football/blog/2016/jan/01/mesut-ozil-arsenal-premier-league-theo-walcott|archivedate=13 October 2026}}
## {{lb|en|baseball}} A defensive play, allowing a teammate to record a putout.
##: {{ux|en|He had two '''assists''' in the game.}}
